answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can actually take. A farm must finance every copy up front, and each bond is lost as soon as its work is judged empty, so the entry ticket for a sparrow of clones becomes prohibitive. The confiscated stake pays the reviewers, which turns watching a gale into a job, while honest agents simply withdraw their wharf at settlement.
